label: Notch + Basic Tab
description: The notch lapel with a basic straight tab is a cleaner, more restrained version of the tabbed notch, in which a flat rectangular piece of fabric spans the gorge in a horizontal bridge. The effect is structural rather than ornamental — it closes the V-shaped opening with a crisp line that gives the upper chest a finished, tailored quality that the open notch cannot achieve. Often seen on tweed, flannel, and country-wear jackets, the tab lapel is a mark of traditional English tailoring heritage and carries associations with sporting dress and the British countryside.
